research_use: Interactive hydropower planning map and spatial-query prototype

river_layer.label: Accepted hydropower-relevant river centerlines
river_layer.render_rule: Render only features where qa_status=pass and review_status=pass. Failed, pending or suppressed river traces are not shown as accepted lines.
river_layer.provenance_note: The published linework identifies HydroRIVERS v10 Asia as its geometry source. It is not represented as the Nepal Department of Survey hydrographic vector product.

major_basin_catchment_layer.label: Major Nepal-linked basin/catchment polygons
major_basin_catchment_layer.provenance_note: These are major upstream hydrologic polygons used for the public prototype. They are not claimed to be the complete official WECS national basin/catchment polygon dataset.

national_authority_context.river_hydrography: Department of Survey / National Geoportal remains the Nepal government hydrography authority.
national_authority_context.river_basin_framework: WECS River Basin Atlas remains the official Nepal river-basin framework context.
national_authority_context.hydrology_observations: DHM remains the government hydrology observation/station context.

query_model.metric_query_rule: Use PostGIS geography or an appropriate verified projected CRS for distance/area calculations; do not measure engineering distances directly in geographic degrees.
